properties.Mechanism (MOA): Inhibit NKCC2 in thick ascending limb → strong natriuresis/diuresis → ↓ECF volume → ↓CO → ↓BP (useful when volume overloaded). / 抑制髓袢升支粗段NKCC2 → 强效排钠利尿 → 容量↓ → CO↓ → 血压↓（容量负荷高时更有用）。
properties.Contraindications: Severe volume depletion. / 严重容量不足禁用/慎用。
properties.Indications: Edema/HF; HTN with CKD/volume overload (not typical first-line for uncomplicated HTN). / 水肿/心衰；CKD或容量负荷过高相关高血压（单纯HTN一般非一线）。
properties.Adverse effects: Hypokalemia, dehydration, ototoxicity (dose-related), metabolic alkalosis. / 低钾、脱水、耳毒性（剂量相关）、代谢性碱中毒。
